label: Project country identifier
definition: Stable ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 identifier used to integrate project sources
allowed_values: BWA; SWZ; LSO; MWI; MOZ; NAM; ZAF; ZMB; ZWE

label: Project country name
definition: Readable project label for the country
allowed_values: Botswana; Eswatini; Lesotho; Malawi; Mozambique; Namibia; South Africa; Zambia; Zimbabwe

label: FAOSTAT country label
definition: Area label retained from the prepared FAOSTAT input
allowed_values: Botswana; Eswatini; Lesotho; Malawi; Mozambique; Namibia; South Africa; Zambia; Zimbabwe
notes: Retained for lineage and crosswalk review.

label: Season and yield year
definition: FAOSTAT calendar year joined to the CHIRPS season ending in that year
notes: The temporal alignment is an explicit teaching assumption.

label: Maize yield
definition: FAOSTAT maize yield converted from kilograms per hectare
missing_values: blank represents missing or unavailable yield

label: Maize production
missing_values: blank represents missing or unavailable production

label: Maize harvested area
missing_values: blank represents missing or unavailable area

label: Log maize yield
definition: Natural logarithm of positive maize yield
missing_values: blank when yield is missing or non-positive
notes: Do not interpret without the untransformed yield variable.

label: Growing-season precipitation
definition: Sum of country-area mean daily CHIRPS precipitation from October through April
missing_values: blank means no matching CHIRPS observation

label: Season start date
definition: First date represented in the precipitation total
missing_values: blank means no matching CHIRPS observation

label: Season end date
definition: Last date represented in the precipitation total
missing_values: blank means no matching CHIRPS observation

label: Precipitation days observed
definition: Number of daily country summaries used in the total
missing_values: blank means no matching CHIRPS observation
